{{Quote|Ah, Corellian ale. There's nothing better. I've never had a Naboo ale that even comes close.|[[Ados Jarkey]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CaEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Chase an Escaped Murderer|Naboo}}</ref>}}
